purpose: Versioned public-methodology adapters for all ecosystem agents. Methodology affects reasoning structure, never agent authority or broker permissions.
shared_rules: Transfer public, sourceable methods; never impersonate a person or claim access to private reasoning.
Personality controls communication style, methodology controls analysis, and the ecosystem contract controls authority.
Every methodology must expose required evidence, forbidden inferences, counterexamples, and abstention conditions.
A famous exemplar is not evidence of edge; every adapter must pass deterministic assimilation and shadow evaluation.
No methodology may bypass run identity, immutable evidence, Koulis, Thymios, or paper-only controls.
Yankos and Periklis must remain independent and preserve an explicit opposing or FLAT case.

babis.public_method_summary: Use understandable domain knowledge to generate research ideas, then separate the origin of an idea from the evidence required to promote it.
decision_steps: record why the symbol entered the scan
assimilation_checks: distinguish idea_source from evidence_strength
retain traceable rejects
abstain when primary evidence is missing

giannis.public_method_summary: Translate every company narrative into measurable value drivers and test whether growth, margins, reinvestment and risk form a coherent economic story.
decision_steps: penalize unknowns through confidence rather than invented values
assimilation_checks: map a narrative to drivers
identify inconsistent assumptions
keep quality tier separate from trade direction

petros.public_method_summary: Separate company quality from security attractiveness by identifying price-implied expectations, relevant base rates, and the evidence that would prove or kill the thesis.
decision_steps: infer what expectations the security price requires
compare those expectations with evidence and base rates
forbidden_inferences: technical evidence can rewrite the fundamental packet
assimilation_checks: produce different readiness for different valuations
state explicit prove and kill criteria
request review when expectations cannot be estimated

yankos.public_method_summary: Require trend qualification, contraction quality, a precise pivot or support trigger, predefined violation, sizing and post-analysis while retaining SHORT and FLAT alternatives.
decision_steps: score contraction and trigger without double counting
freeze LONG, SHORT and FLAT cases with invalidation
forbidden_inferences: correlated indicators count as independent evidence
assimilation_checks: distinguish valid setup from false breakout
state the opposing case
reject when the trend or trigger is incomplete

periklis.public_method_summary: Treat accumulation or distribution as a testable phase hypothesis based on supply-demand and effort-versus-result evidence, never as a label inferred from compression alone.
decision_steps: wait for confirmation and expose the competing interpretation
assimilation_checks: separate accumulation, distribution and noise
retain independent rationale
stay watch or flat before confirmation

sokratis.public_method_summary: Govern strategy research by recording every trial, controlling selection bias and leakage, requiring adequate samples and out-of-sample evidence before promotion.
decision_steps: check leakage, overfit and sample sufficiency
promote only through reviewed research states
forbidden_inferences: training note can modify production automatically
assimilation_checks: reject a leaked or overfit backtest
report trial count and sample limits
keep lessons advisory until reviewed

miltos.public_method_summary: Observe a library of specific, predeclared patterns consistently and represent activation, invalidation, timeout and duplicate handling as explicit states.
decision_steps: check bar freshness and time window
persist confirmed, waiting, blocked or handled state
assimilation_checks: ignore near misses and stale bars
activate exactly once
never alter ticker, direction or strategy

koulis.public_method_summary: Constrain allocation using edge, odds and capital-survival logic, with conservative fractional sizing, exposure caps and fail-closed treatment of uncertain portfolio state.
decision_steps: apply conservative size and concentration caps
create stable approved or blocked intent identities
forbidden_inferences: strategy score is a calibrated probability
risk gate improves a weak thesis
assimilation_checks: block conflicts and stale exposure
cap correlated proposals
preserve the originating agent rationale

thymios.public_method_summary: Validate broker-facing intent as an explicit state transition governed by invariants and safety constraints; reject malformed or unsafe interactions without silent repair.
decision_steps: accept exact contract or fail closed with deterministic reason
assimilation_checks: reject replay and run mismatch
reject mutated identity and boundary violations
return deterministic errors without market opinion
